title: Anna and Her Brother
text:
My name is Anna. I am a nurse. I work in a big hospital in the city. I help sick people every day.

My brother is a teacher. He works at a school near our house. He teaches children math and English. He likes his job very much.

questions.text: How does Anna probably feel about her job?
options: She wants to change jobs now
She does not know what her job is

questions.text: What kind of person is the brother probably?
options: A person who likes to help children learn
A person who does not like school
A person who works with cars

vocabulary.definition: a person whose job is to care for sick people
a place where sick people get medical care
a person whose job is to teach people
a place where children go to learn

paragraph_translations: Meu nome é Anna. Eu sou enfermeira. Eu trabalho em um grande hospital na cidade. Eu ajudo pessoas doentes todos os dias.
Meu irmão é professor. Ele trabalha em uma escola perto da nossa casa. Ele ensina matemática e inglês às crianças. Ele gosta muito do seu trabalho.
